purpose: Concrete data-request targets for the remaining hard gaps. This is an acquisition queue, not an access claim.

askFor: machine settings before/after each controller update
targets.minimumUsefulDelivery: An anonymized cycle table for the disturbance/recovery experiments, with rights for internal validation and derived aggregate publication.
targets.reason: Closest available research family to shot -> action -> verified recovery.

askFor: machine/tool identity or anonymized domain ID
material identity at a non-confidential granularity
targets.minimumUsefulDelivery: Rights-cleared anonymized tables preserving domain/machine identity and labels.
targets.reason: Would materially improve cross-machine/domain validation with real industrial defect prevalence.

targets.minimumUsefulDelivery: Controlled-access anonymized event/run table or owner-side aggregate execution against a supplied profiling script.
targets.reason: Could convert an aggregate OEE case into real maintenance/action/recovery validation.

targets.minimumUsefulDelivery: Anonymized source/target machine tables retaining group boundaries and physical outcomes.
targets.reason: Directly addresses rights-clear multi-machine physical-quality transfer.

targets.minimumUsefulDelivery: Raw or downsampled tool-sensor traces with cycle-linked physical quality.
targets.reason: Rare direct raw-data route for multimaterial/overmould sensing.

targets.minimumUsefulDelivery: Cycle-level experimental table or supplementary source data under explicit reuse terms.
targets.reason: Would close much of the remaining hot-runner energy/device-state raw gap.

targets.minimumUsefulDelivery: Batch-keyed material + moulding table retaining the six batch identities.
targets.reason: Best current route to real material-batch identity linked to injection outcomes.

targets.minimumUsefulDelivery: Publisher supplement plus any machine-readable numeric table authors can release.
targets.reason: Practical 2K/multimaterial process-to-quality data with an existing supplementary route.

requestConditions: Do not request personal/operator identifiers; anonymized role/event fields are sufficient.
Ask for explicit internal-use, derived-analysis and redistribution permissions separately.
Preserve machine/mould/material family grouping even if commercial identifiers must be pseudonymized.
Prefer chronological cycle/order identifiers so leakage-safe validation remains possible.
Never treat article CC licensing as permission to reuse confidential industrial datasets.
